crash.messageConfig: The settings file could not be read. Fix it or delete it, then start {app} again.
crash.messageCrash: Something inside {app} failed. Send the report so it can be fixed, then restart.
crash.messageHang: It may still finish what it is doing. Wait, or close it and send a report.
crash.messageHangStopped: {app} was closed while it was not responding. Send the report so it can be fixed, then restart.
crash.messageKilled: {app} was closed before it could report anything. Send the report so it can be fixed, then restart.
crash.messageOom: The system ran out of memory and closed {app}. Send the report, then restart.
crash.messageStartup: Fix the cause below, then start {app} again.
